Faq.title: Answers, clearly.
Faq.intro: What patients often ask before their first visit.
Faq.q1Question: How do I book a consultation?
Faq.q1Answer: Call us, message us on WhatsApp, or use the booking form on this page. Our team will help you schedule a convenient appointment.
Faq.q2Question: Where is Pearlcrest Dental Clinic located?
Faq.q2Answer: We are in Office 102, Dar Al Nahda Building, Hor Al Anz East, Dubai, UAE.
Faq.q3Answer: Our services include teeth whitening, root canal treatment, dental veneers, and general dental care. Your clinician will recommend the right approach during consultation.
Faq.q4Answer: Patient comfort is central to every visit. We take time to explain procedures and ensure you feel at ease throughout your care.
Faq.q5Question: Can I contact the clinic on WhatsApp?
Faq.q5Answer: Yes. You can reach us on WhatsApp at +971 52 851 6434 for enquiries and appointment requests.
Faq.q6Answer: Our team can assist patients in Arabic, English, and French.
